blockers.evidence: I03 lists critique-only, constructive attack and generic creativity, while PLAN says all six generative comparisons include ordinary and generic controls. Track A explicitly proposed O,G,critique,construction. One unnamed shared role is not an assessed equal-two-role ordinary control.
blockers.required_repair: Name and schedule the ordinary arm at matched evidence/output/role budget, or identify an exact reusable matched ordinary output with complete assessments and all cache identities. Update study totals, review coverage and PLAN. Do not silently equate critique with ordinary analysis.

blockers.evidence: I11 retains eight factorial cells and the ordinary all-off cell, but drops Track A's generic comparator. PLAN requires creation credit against both concurrent controls. I02-I07 generic outputs use two roles, whereas I11 uses three stages, so reuse is not automatically matched.
blockers.required_repair: Retain the eight cells and specify a matched three-stage generic control with budget/assessment coverage, or explicitly gate generic-exclusive novelty credit until such an exact comparator is bound. Distinguish valid factorial instruction effects from novelty above generic creativity; preserve the generic-control obligation rather than treating omission as completion.

blockers.evidence: I10 pilot and confirmation both list eight sets, with confirmation labeled fresh, but the only deterministic source binding is the first four I06 confirmation blocks once. A repeated upstream wave is charged only for optional human confirmation.
blockers.required_repair: Define deterministic I10 as one exposure pass over the eight fixed sets with no fresh-confirmation claim, or bind eight new sets/four new I06 cases and charge the repeated upstream wave and overhead. Record the stage-specific dependency; human-confirmation charges must not silently finance a separate deterministic confirmation.
